title: PCSS Custody Envelope
description: Data-minimization and deletion-rights envelope. Carries retention declarations, deletion requests, and deletion-completion receipts. See PCSS §8.

custody_id.description: Stable, opaque identifier for this custody envelope.

action.description: The custody action this envelope represents.

subject_ref.description: Opaque reference to the subject of this custody envelope. MUST be either a bearing_id (per-child) or a consent_id (per-consent-grant). MUST NOT carry user-identifying data.

scope.description: Data scopes affected. 'all' MUST be supported for full deletion. Per-scope deletion uses the same vocabulary as Threshold granted_scope.

retention_until.description: For retention-declaration: the timestamp beyond which the implementer commits not to retain the data. Default per §8.1: issued_at + 180 days. Statutory overrides (e.g., CSAM evidence preservation) MUST be cited in 'statutory_basis'.

statutory_basis.description: Statute citations that override the default retention. e.g., '18 U.S.C. §2258A' for CSAM preservation.

propagation_deadline.description: For deletion-request: the timestamp by which the deletion MUST be propagated to downstream consumers (§8.2 default: 30 days from issued_at).

completion_receipt.description: For deletion-completion: confirmation that the deletion was executed.

downstream_consumers.description: Registered identifiers of downstream consumers to which the deletion was propagated.

tombstone_id.description: Opaque tombstone identifier retained for audit purposes after the data itself is deleted.

issuer.description: Registered identifier of the entity emitting the envelope.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 country code with optional sub-region.
